Found **one payload-budget blocker**. I found no record-authentication regression in `da56bcb0` against exact parent `68294a2e`; the three source hashes match the contract.

**Blockers**

- **The lower admission cap exposes uncharged live metadata during upload.** [two_bit_store.rs:560](/home/rb/worktrees/borsuk-bounded-publication-validation/crates/borsuk/src/two_bit_store.rs:560) passes `max_memory_bytes − already_pinned_bytes` to the uploader while retaining the root bytes, decoded manifest, plane receipt, page manifest, and roster. [resident_graph_store.rs:318](/home/rb/worktrees/borsuk-bounded-publication-validation/crates/borsuk/src/resident_graph_store.rs:318) permits two buffers to consume that entire allowance; the second allocation occurs at line 347. With a **16 MiB remaining cap**, two full **8 MiB** buffers exhaust it before counting the retained metadata. This accounting predates the patch, but the new admission makes additional cases reachable.

  **Smallest falsifier:** a valid graph generation with 32,768 rows, D768, and compact one-layer cycle graphs. Its records alone contribute 18.75 MiB to the former `3 × records` model, so eager admission rejects 16 MiB; the new metadata/page model can admit it. Its canonical file exceeds 8 MiB, triggering both full upload buffers. This is a source-derived counterexample, **not an executed result**.

  **Smallest fix:** subtract a checked, conservative reserve for currently live publisher metadata before passing the upload allowance. Keep caller pins counted once.

- **Native acceptance remains unverified here.** Integration still requires the authorized child’s exact-revision test results, required Clippy command, and complete workspace test-build gate. Formatting and source inspection cannot establish those results.

**Nonblocking limitations**

- **Cancellation evidence covers the first yield after local validation.** The synchronous loop at [two_bit_source.rs:546](/home/rb/worktrees/borsuk-bounded-publication-validation/crates/borsuk/src/two_bit_source.rs:546) has no cancellation point. The test at [two_bit_generation.rs:2872](/home/rb/worktrees/borsuk-bounded-publication-validation/crates/borsuk/src/two_bit_generation.rs:2872) completes that scan before dropping the future. It supports pre-upload head safety, not prompt cancellation during scanning.

- **Filesystem safety depends on immutable inputs.** The `symlink_metadata` check and subsequent `File::open` are separate operations. Swapping a regular file for a FIFO between them can still block. This does not violate the documented immutable-input precondition; it limits any stronger filesystem claim.

- **The improvement bounds record-scanning memory, not total memory independently of corpus size.** Digest tables remain resident, and [two_bit_store.rs:537](/home/rb/worktrees/borsuk-bounded-publication-validation/crates/borsuk/src/two_bit_store.rs:537) still loads complete semantic leaves and centroids under separate admission.

The shared `PageAuthority`, reusable page buffer, full SHA, and terminal length probe preserve the relevant eager checks with a small mechanism. The temporary generation is dropped before later validation/uploads, and serving entry points retain their existing mode.

No files edited or Cargo/native/cloud jobs launched.

Reviewed `da56bcb080f559c81886e4e603226bd5e5415564` against `68294a2e67a298006ac79f4dfc96e76e1f7a4ddf`. The isolated worktree and all three source hashes match the contract.

**No source-level correctness or security blocker found. Integration remains result-gated.**

**Blockers / missing proof**

- **Native verification is outstanding.** The supplied evidence does not establish compilation, test execution, Clippy, or workspace test-build success. Collect the authorized serial gate results on this exact revision before integration.
- **The selected gates omit execution of the existing graph publication integration test.** The publisher replacement applies to both discovery modes, but the contract selects library tests; the workspace script uses [`--no-run`]( /home/rb/worktrees/borsuk-bounded-publication-validation/scripts/check_rust_test_build.sh:30). Existing coverage exercises publication, replacement, stale writers, and old-root reload in [two_bit_generation.rs](/home/rb/worktrees/borsuk-bounded-publication-validation/crates/borsuk/tests/two_bit_generation.rs:415). Smallest additional proof: execute `cargo test --locked -p borsuk --test two_bit_generation` in the authorized lane.

**Nonblocking limitations**

- **Cancellation does not interrupt the local scan.** The async publisher calls synchronous validation at [two_bit_store.rs:419](/home/rb/worktrees/borsuk-bounded-publication-validation/crates/borsuk/src/two_bit_store.rs:419); [the page loop](/home/rb/worktrees/borsuk-bounded-publication-validation/crates/borsuk/src/two_bit_source.rs:546) has no yield or cancellation check. The [new cancellation test](/home/rb/worktrees/borsuk-bounded-publication-validation/crates/borsuk/src/two_bit_generation.rs:2872) drops the future only after validation finishes. This retains an existing limitation, but newly admissible large files make it more consequential. A single-worker heartbeat/abort check during scanning would falsify any responsiveness claim.
- **Regular-file checks assume immutable, trusted staging.** [`symlink_metadata` followed by `File::open`](/home/rb/worktrees/borsuk-bounded-publication-validation/crates/borsuk/src/two_bit_source.rs:529) rejects static nonregular artifacts but is not race-proof against local replacement. That is consistent with the publisher’s existing immutable-input contract; it must not be presented as protection against a malicious local writer.
- **The memory test proves modeled admission, not measured peak memory.** [Its assertions](/home/rb/worktrees/borsuk-bounded-publication-validation/crates/borsuk/src/two_bit_generation.rs:2558) establish an empty resident-record vector and admission below the eager model. They do not measure allocator, runtime, or upload-buffer peaks.

The central mechanism holds under inspection: [checked admission includes one validation page](/home/rb/worktrees/borsuk-bounded-publication-validation/crates/borsuk/src/two_bit_generation.rs:1109); the scanner checks exact length, every page digest, trailing bytes, and whole-file SHA. The shared schema, mean, identity, and router checks remain. Validation metadata is dropped before semantic validation/uploads, and new validation failures occur before publication writes. Serving entry points and head CAS ordering are unchanged.

Read-only inspection only; no files changed or native checks run.

decision: Repair uncharged publisher metadata before upload; include graph publication integration execution; freeze repaired source for remote qualification. Source review is not native PASS or measured RSS.
